eligibility: The nominated Leçons de mathématiques d'aujourd'hui series collects introductory research lectures from Bordeaux's doctoral school. Its chapters introduce advanced fields, their technical objects and current methods to students, teachers and scientific professionals.
reason: Hard-exclude the technical research-orientation lecture series. The publisher's broad invitation and accessible exposition do not remove its specialist-training structure. This is not a historical narrative. Cassini's catalog access failed, so confidence rests on the detailed French mathematics-education catalog and the publisher description reproduced by the bookseller.

eligibility: Doyle and Snell's actual text develops a technical bridge between random walks, Dirichlet problems and resistor networks. Its staged derivations, repeated exercises and solution methods teach readers how to apply electrical-network techniques to probability problems.
reason: Hard-exclude this instructional mathematical monograph. The preface's aim of explaining physics–mathematics interplay is real, but the inspected full text remains a specialist-method introduction. The title's conceptual appeal and its use of intuitive stories cannot override H2.
